title: Korea Apartment Pre-Move-In Funding Dataset 2026
description: A verified reference dataset for comparing apartment pre-move-in funding requirements in South Korea. Based on 2026 January-September initial housing recruitment notices, the project standardizes contract deposits, interim payments, balance structure, financing support, and explicitly self-paid interim payments. The validation universe contains 196 projects; 82 have verified payment and financing structures, 81 support calculation of the standardized pre-move-in funding ratio, and a conservative 41-project subset is released for external reuse.
